name: Sanjay Manchanda
abstract_title: Shifting Into a High-Frequency State: Significant Subjective and EEG Effects of Ultra High Frequency Photobiomodulation
abstract: Photobiomodulation (PBM) has gained increasing attention as a non-invasive neuromodulatory approach capable of influencing meditation depth and brain network dynamics relevant to meditation, attention, and altered states of consciousness. We have recently demonstrated that pulsed photobiomodulation (PBM) enhances meditation and alters electrophysiological markers linked to focused attention and mystical experiences.
